name: Link
summary: Text that navigates, or acts like a button while reading as text. Choose it over a subtle or transparent Button when the action sits inside or beside running text; inline marks one inside a sentence, where it is always underlined.

inputs.name: href
inputs.description: Native href. With it the link renders as an anchor and inherits the surrounding font size; without it, as a button at fontSizeBase300.

inputs.name: appearance
inputs.description: default is brand-coloured; subtle is neutral Foreground 2 until hovered.

inputs.name: inline
inputs.description: The link sits inside running text: underlined at rest, not only on hover.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disabled colour, no underline, no activation; removed from the tab order.

inputs.name: disabledFocusable
inputs.description: Looks disabled and ignores activation but stays focusable, to keep a stable tab order.

inputs.name: onClick
inputs.description: Runs on click, or on Enter while focused.

anatomy.name: Link
anatomy.description: An inline anchor, button or span holding the text; the only part.

variants.description: Brand link colour, stepping to its Hover and Pressed tokens.
Neutral Foreground 2 link colour, stepping to its Hover and Pressed tokens.
Set by an inverted-background context, not a prop: colorBrandForegroundInverted at rest, hover and press alike; overrides appearance.
Set by a brand-background context: the inverted neutral link family, stepping on hover and press; overrides appearance.

layout.text: The link is display inline with no margin, padding or background, left-aligned, and inherits overflow and text-overflow so it truncates with its container; its text stays selectable.
The text is fontFamilyBase at fontWeightRegular and fontSizeBase300; an anchor with an href inherits the surrounding font size instead. No line height is set, so it takes the surrounding one.
Any underline is strokeWidthThin thick, in the text's colour.
Rendered as a button, the link drops the native button border so it reads as text.

states.text: Rest: the appearance's link colour, underlined only when inline.
The text underlines and takes the Hover link token; the pointer is a hand. Instant.
The text underlines and takes the Pressed link token.
A custom indicator, not createFocusOutlineStyle: on keyboard focus (focus-visible only) the outline is removed and the text gets a double underline in colorStrokeFocus2.
colorNeutralForegroundDisabled with no underline at rest, hover or press, and the not-allowed pointer; this overrides appearance, background and inline.

behaviour.text: With an href the link renders as an anchor and navigates; without one it renders as a button and runs onClick. It may also render as a span.
disabledFocusable keeps the link in the tab order with its focus underline but ignores activation and reports aria-disabled.
Colour and underline change instantly; the styles file declares no transition.

keyboard: Enter activates it (Space too when it renders as a button)
semantics: link when it has an href, button otherwise

notes.text: The hit area is the inline text box, which nothing sizes: at fontSizeBase300 it is about 14px tall, well under the foundations' 24px minimum. Give standalone links vertical room in the layout.
Disabled is merged last, so a disabled inline link loses its underline and reads as plain grey text in a sentence.
On an inverted background the link has no hover or pressed colour change, only the underline; on a brand background it steps through the inverted-link tokens. The asymmetry is in the code.

Only disabled has a forced-colours rule: GrayText at rest, hover and press, since links have no native disabled state. Otherwise the browser's forced link colour and the high-contrast theme apply; the double-underline focus indicator survives because it is a text decoration, not an outline.
Guidance on when to prefer a link over a subtle button follows the design site.
